description: Phinite: refuse reads and commands that would print a .env file's values (names-only is fine).

hooks.command: for d in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; do g="$d/hooks/env_guard.py"; if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$g" ]; then p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || break; exec "$p" "$g" --client codex; fi; done; exit 0
